assignmentHtml.task:
全面调查 WWE 的 YouTube 频道。查明以下事项：

  1. 稳定频道 ID 及规范 URL。
  2. 运营方：World Wrestling Entertainment Inc.。母公司：Endeavor/Turner（WWE 于 2023 年被 Endeavor 收购，并与 UFC 合并）。
  3. 频道创建日期，以及目前仍公开的最早上传视频。
  4. 运营地点及频道显示的国家。
  5. 使用的语言。
  6. 主要内容类别（体育娱乐／摔角）。
  7. 内容供应模式：广播电视机构的节目存档／精彩片段。
  8. 代表性系列／活动。提供直接来源 URL。
assignmentHtml.context: 根据 Communitrics 于 2026 年 9 月 2 日的快照，WWE 排名第 14 名，历史累计观看量约为 107B（1070 亿）次。需要可核实的事实，并附来源链接。
assignmentHtml.expected_output: 一份关于 WWE 的结构化资料，包含全部要求的字段，每个字段均附来源 URL。

answerHtml:
WWE YouTube Channel Dossier

  1. STABLE CHANNEL ID & CANONICAL URL
  • Channel ID: UCJ5v_MCY6GNUBTO8-D3XoAg
  • Canonical (ID-based) URL: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCJ5v_MCY6GNUBTO8-D3XoAg
  • Handle-based URL: https://www.youtube.com/@WWE (formerly youtube.com/wwefannation when the channel was named WWEFanNation)
  • Sources: Social Blade [1], Wikipedia List of Most-Viewed Channels [2], Wikitubia [3]
  1. OPERATOR & PARENT COMPANY
  • Operator: World Wrestling Entertainment, Inc.
  • Parent: TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO). WWE merged with UFC under Endeavor to form TKO, which closed on September 12, 2023. Endeavor initially held 51%, WWE shareholders 49%. As of April 2026, The WME Group (via Silver Lake) holds ~63.9% of TKO. WWE operates as a division under TKO, led by President Nick Khan and Chief Content Officer Paul 'Triple H' Levesque.
  • Sources: TKO Group Holdings Wikipedia [4], WWE Wikipedia [5], Social Blade [1]
  1. CHANNEL CREATION DATE & EARLIEST STILL-PUBLIC UPLOAD
  • Date joined YouTube: May 11, 2007 (per Social Blade; confirmed in Wikitubia prose: 'Although WWE first joined YouTube on May 11, 2007...')
  • Earliest still-public upload: 'WWE No Way Out' (trailer for No Way Out 2008 PPV), uploaded February 7, 2008. The company did not post its first video until nearly a year after joining. This video remains public with ~1.23M views.
  • Note: A Wikitubia infobox field reads 'August 28, 2005,' but the same page's prose states May 11, 2007, and Social Blade confirms May 11, 2007. The August 28, 2005 date appears to be erroneous or refers to something else on that page.
  • Sources: Social Blade [1], Wikitubia [3], YouTube video page [6], Reddit r/SquaredCircle corroboration [7]
  1. OPERATING LOCATION & DISPLAYED COUNTRY
  • Operating location: 707 Washington Blvd, Stamford, Connecticut 06901, United States (WWE corporate headquarters; moved from Titan Towers at 1241 E Main St to the new HQ in 2023)
  • Displayed country on YouTube: United States
  • Sources: WWE Wikipedia [5], WWE Contact page [8], Wikipedia Most-Viewed Channels list [2], Wikitubia [3]
  1. LANGUAGES
  • Primary language: English
  • WWE programming is distributed in 30+ languages globally across its platforms
  • Sources: Wikipedia Most-Viewed Channels list [2], WWE Wikipedia [5]
  1. PRIMARY CONTENT CATEGORY
  • Category: Sports / Entertainment (specifically 'sports entertainment' — WWE's own marketing term for its scripted athletic-performance product)
  • Ranked as the #1 most-subscribed Sports channel on YouTube
  • Sources: Communitrics snapshot [9], Wikipedia Most-Viewed Channels [2], Shorty Awards [10]
  1. CONTENT SUPPLY MODEL
  • Broadcaster archives and highlights: Daily clips from weekly TV products (Raw, SmackDown, NXT); PLE pre-shows; news announcements; extensive historical archive including full matches, promos, and classic footage from decades of WWE television dating back to the 1980s and earlier NWA territory content.
  • Full-episode distribution: Under a multi-year partnership with YouTube (announced 2012), WWE uploaded complete episodes of Friday Night SmackDown, NXT, Superstars, and ECW — among the first primetime TV episodes on YouTube.
  • Original programming: Exclusive series such as Fallout (post-match locker room interviews), Top 10 (weekly rankings), WWE Game Night, Superstar Ink, My Son/Daughter is a WWE Superstar.
  • Live streaming: Major events including WrestleMania stream on the channel.
  • Companion channels: WWE Vault and WCW Vault for rare archival content.
  • Approximately 96,000+ videos uploaded, multiple posts per day.
  • Sources: SI.com milestone article [11], WWE/YouTube partnership announcement [12], Shorty Awards [10], Wikitubia [3]
  1. REPRESENTATIVE SERIES/EVENTS
  • Weekly television brands: Monday Night Raw, Friday Night SmackDown, NXT
  • Premium Live Events (major PPVs): WrestleMania, SummerSlam, Royal Rumble, Survivor Series, Money in the Bank, No Way Out
  • YouTube-original series: Fallout, Top 10, WWE Game Night, Superstar Ink
  • Archive series: Full matches from classic events (e.g., WrestleMania 28 Cena vs. Rock, SummerSlam 2005 Mysterio vs. Guerrero), plus NWA/territory content via WWE Vault and WCW Vault channels
  • Sources: SI.com [11], Shorty Awards [10], WWE Wikipedia [5]
  1. COMMUNITRICS SNAPSHOT VERIFICATION (Sept 2, 2026)
  • Rank: #14 most subscribed YouTube channel globally
  • Subscribers: 114 million
  • Lifetime views: 107 billion
  • Category: Sports · Entertainment
  • Source: top.communitrics.com daily snapshot [9]

evidence.snippet: The WWE YouTube channel regularly hosts daily clips from the company's weekly television products Raw, SmackDown, and NXT, and is also home to PLE pre-shows and other various news announcements... The channel is also home to various archive content, including popular and historical matches, clips, promos, and other top content from decades of footage.

evidence.supports: Representative original series (Fallout, Top 10, Game Night, Superstar Ink) and event coverage (WrestleMania live streams).
